answer.thought: It is nearly noon. My plan was to be at the IIC by now, but the body is a stubborn fact that has not yet received its fuel. I have not eaten in over a day, and the kitchen is silent because Ramesh waits for wages I have not yet arranged. I shall sit on the step and read the papers again, not for news, but to keep my mind occupied until I can face the practical necessity of feeding myself.
